featuredProject.name: Vaultly — Multi-Tenant RAG Platform
featuredProject.description: A secure, multi-tenant Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform engineered with database-level isolation, transactional outbox streaming, and rigorous evaluation.

feature.details: Forced PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, least-privilege DB role, composite foreign keys preventing cross-tenant data leakage.
JWT access tokens, rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection, role-based access control (RBAC).
Kafka / Redpanda pipeline with transactional outbox pattern, idempotent consumers, dead-letter queues.
Hybrid search (pgvector HNSW + full-text RRF) with reranking, permission-aware at query time.
recall@k, MRR, faithfulness scoring, and config-by-config ablation testing.
